tools.name: save_url
tools.description: Save a URL to the Wayback Machine for archival using the SPN2 API. Supports capturing screenshots, outlinks, and conditional archiving. Set WAYBACK_ACCESS_KEY and WAYBACK_SECRET_KEY env vars for higher SPN2 rate limits.

url.description: The URL to save to the Wayback Machine

captureScreenshot.description: Capture a screenshot of the page as a PNG image (uses the im_ modifier)

captureOutlinks.description: Also archive up to 100 outlink pages linked from this URL

ifNotArchivedWithin.description: Skip if archived within timeframe, e.g. "30d" (30 days), "1h" (1 hour)

jsBehaviorTimeout.description: Run JavaScript for N seconds before capturing (max 30)

forceGet.description: Use simple HTTP GET instead of browser rendering (faster but no JS)

delayWbAvailability.description: Delay indexing ~12 hours to reduce server load

tools.name: get_archived_url
tools.description: Retrieve an archived version of a URL from the Wayback Machine. Returns the snapshot content. Supports URL modifiers: id_ (raw content), im_ (screenshot image), js_ (JavaScript), cs_ (CSS).

url.description: The URL to retrieve from the Wayback Machine

timestamp.description: Specific timestamp (YYYYMMDDhhmmss) or "latest" for most recent

modifier.description: URL modifier: id_ (raw content, no toolbar), im_ (screenshot image), js_ (JavaScript), cs_ (CSS). Default: id_

tools.name: search_archives
tools.description: Search the Wayback Machine CDX API for archived versions of a URL. Supports match types (exact/prefix/host/domain), date range filtering, collapsing duplicates, field filtering, pagination, and duplicate counting.

url.description: The URL pattern to search for

matchType.description: URL match scope: exact (default), prefix (all under path), host, or domain (with subdomains)

collapse.description: Collapse adjacent duplicates by field, e.g. "timestamp:8" (per hour), "digest" (unique content)

filter.description: Filter by field regex, e.g. ["statuscode:200", "!mimetype:image.*"]. Prefix with ! to negate.

resolveRevisits.description: Resolve warc/revisit entries to their original mimetype and status code

showDupeCount.description: Show duplicate count per capture (grouped by digest)

tools.name: check_archive_status
tools.description: Check if a URL has been archived by the Wayback Machine and get capture statistics including yearly breakdowns.

url.description: The URL to check archival status for

tools.name: list_screenshots
tools.description: List available screenshots for a URL from the Wayback Machine. Screenshots are generated when captures are made with capture_screenshot=1.

url.description: The URL to find screenshots for

tools.name: clear_cache
tools.description: Clear all cached Wayback Machine API responses. Use when fresh data is needed or after saving a URL.

tools.name: compare_snapshots
tools.description: Compare two archived snapshots of a URL. Fetches the raw content of both snapshots and provides a visual diff URL. If no timestamps specified, compares the oldest and newest available snapshots.

url.description: The URL to compare snapshots for

timestampA.description: First timestamp (YYYYMMDDhhmmss). Defaults to oldest available.

timestampB.description: Second timestamp (YYYYMMDDhhmmss). Defaults to newest available.
